propositions: The plan-review close gate refuses to close tickets with a live supersedes or duplicates link under their matching administrative disposition class, even though the completion-verification gate already exempts such dispositions.

A reviewer cannot pass plan-review attestation for a genuinely superseded ticket because the review correctly blocks on findings that the planned work already exists elsewhere, making the attestation requirement unsatisfiable by construction.

The close_plan_review_gate_check function does not receive the close disposition (close_class) as a parameter, so it cannot evaluate whether to exempt link-backed administrative dispositions despite having evidence available at the call site.

The gate exemption for link-backed dispositions (superseded, duplicate) must be conditioned on both the disposition class AND the presence of a live replacement link, to prevent bypass of verification when evidence is absent.

Force-closing a legitimately superseded ticket with --force records no signed attestation, degrading the audit trail of the ticket and propagating unsigned status up the entire ancestor chain in an epic.
Distinguishing an evidence-backed administrative close from an unaudited force bypass requires the gate to return a distinct verdict rather than reusing the exempt category.
